programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 1
programme.desc: We will start this episode with the Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon 2025 with over 55,000 runners from around 80 countries. Then we move to Geneva for another edition of CHI Geneva, Rolex Grand Prix. Finally we move to Saudi Arabia for the 2025 FIBA Asia Cup.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 3 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: Spartan Beast World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Spartan is back again to the culturally rich and visually intoxicating dunes of Abu Dhabi, UAE for the 2025 Spartan World Championship hosted by Abu Dhabi Sports Council. The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 2
programme.desc: We start this episode with one of the most distinctive race venues in global triathlon, Challenge Sir Bani Yas in Abu Dhabi. Staying with triathlons, one of the most exciting triathlon experiences, Portocolom Triathlon, the oldest in the Balearic Islands, is about to return for its 28th edition. We then travel to Mexico for the Powerade Monterrey Marathon 2025. Moving on to Asia for a different kind of a marathon, The Oman Desert Marathon. Changing landscapes, we now move to the picturesque Dolomite Mountains in Northern Italy for the Granfondo Dobbiaco–Cortina Ski Marathon.The Outdoor Sports Show travels to the four corners of the world, presenting events that remain etched in the memory of those who take part in them. One of the most special is the Raid Témiscamingue, set against the backdrop of the wild beauty in Quebec, in Canada.

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: Tour de la Provence 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Since its creation in 2016, the CIC Tour de La Provence has established itself as a key stage on the cycling calendar, offering top riders ideal training grounds for the Tour de France. Between demanding climbs and iconic landscapes, the race tests punchers, climbers, and sprinters, attracting a high-level field each year. More than just a competition, it embodies the popular spirit of cycling and benefits from the support of a passionate region, making each edition an unmissable event of the season.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Mediterranean Epic 2026 Eng

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026

programme.title: Changing Channels

programme.title: All The Way Eng

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng

The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders\/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.
